name: Connector with protective earth contact
summary: A plug and socket in which one contact is the protective earth, usually making first and breaking last.
description: This form identifies a connector where one contact carries the protective conductor. The earth contact is normally longer so it makes before and breaks after the live contacts, keeping the connected equipment earthed whenever it could be energised. The earth pin is drawn with a protective earth mark or PE label.

The symbol does not prove the first-make, last-break feature exists in the selected product, so the connector type must be checked. Where a connector carries power and signals, the earth pin also often serves as the reference for screens, which should be drawn explicitly.
readingNotes: Identify the PE contact and check it is first-make, last-break.
Check that the PE pin is not used as a signal return.
drawingChecklist: Specify a connector with leading earth contact.
Keep PE continuity through both connector halves.
distinction: A connector PE contact carries the protective conductor through a separable joint; a protective earth terminal is a fixed connection point.
